newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO PESO STILL FIRM ON DLR FLOW TO LOCAL MKTS.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO PESO STILL FIRM ON DLR FLOW TO LOCAL MKTS.

text.p: The Mexican peso retained its initial strength in late morning trade Tuesday on a steady flow of foreign capital into the local stock and money markets.

"There are plenty of dollars in the market on investors tracking the bourse and money market, but dollar puts left over are curbing the peso's strength," a dealer said, referring to an estimated $142 million in dollar puts yet to be exercised out of $500 million auctioned by the central bank on July 31.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood 2.3 and 2.0 centavos firmer, respectively, at 7.7815/7.7840 and 7.7780/7.7810 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts closed 2.6 centavos firmer at 7.7750/7.7780 per dollar.
